body_markdown:
LONDON


, Oct. 22, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Brightstar Lottery PLC (NYSE: BRSL) ("Brightstar") announced today that its subsidiary, Brightstar Global Solutions Corporation, has signed a multi-year contract extension with Organización Nacional de Ciegos Espanoles ("ONCE"), through which it will continue to support ONCE's lottery operations in Spain through software enhancements and the continuing evolution of its central gaming system. Brightstar has been the lottery technology supplier to ONCE since 2002.


*"ONCE is pleased to extend our long and successful relationship with Brightstar,"* said **Virginia Castellano, Deputy Director General for Organization, Talent and Resources.** *"Brightstar is the right partner to help us continue evolving our lottery operations, reinforcing our commitment to safe, responsible lotteries with a social purpose, and enabling us to fund a wide range of social programs and services to support people with severe visual impairments and people with other disabilities in Spain."*


*"ONCE is world renowned for its commitment to improving the social and professional inclusion of people with disabilities and Brightstar is honored to serve their lottery operations to support this important work,"* said **Marco Tasso, Brightstar Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer of Global Lottery.** *"We look forward to continue providing ONCE with leading technology solutions for its lottery system."*


**About Brightstar Lottery PLC**


Brightstar Lottery PLC (NYSE: BRSL) is a global leader in lottery focused on innovation and forward-thinking strategies and solutions, building on our renowned expertise in delivering secure technology and producing reliable, comprehensive solutions for our customers. As a premier pure play global lottery company, our best-in-class lottery operations, retail and digital solutions, and award-winning lottery games enable our customers to achieve their goals, entertain players and distribute meaningful benefits to communities. Brightstar has a well-established local presence and is a trusted partner to governments and regulators around the world, creating value by adhering to the highest standards of service, integrity, and responsibility. Brightstar serves nearly 90 lottery customers and their players on six continents. It is the primary technology provider to 26 of the 46 lottery jurisdictions in the U.S. and eight of the world's 10 largest lotteries with central systems. Brightstar has approximately 6,000 employees. For more information, please visit[www.brightstarlottery.com](http://www.brightstarlottery.com/) or follow along on LinkedIn.
